description: Enhanced athletes, alien worlds, artificial bodies, engineered epidemics and first-contact crises force ordinary people to decide what remains human when survival depends on technology, mutation or cooperation with those they were taught to fear.

s04e01.description: An aging competitor receives artificial reflex enhancements for one last deadly tournament and discovers that the performance boost is rapidly consuming his body.

s04e02.description: A survey crew searching another planet for resources believes it is uninhabited until unseen attackers begin striking and the mission's assumptions unravel.

s04e03.description: A reporter films a mysterious man apparently restoring a dying girl to life, drawing both of them into military detention and a conflict between evidence, exploitation and trust.

s04e04.description: Two young people raised in an isolated commune face a terrifying rite surrounding the birth of their child and begin questioning the authority that has defined their entire world.

s04e05.description: A government investigator enters a town devastated by a mysterious childhood epidemic and discovers that the surviving children may hold an explanation of extraterrestrial origin.

s04e06.description: A soldier's mind is transferred into an advanced artificial body for a military experiment, but the death of his original body turns a temporary assignment into an identity crisis.

s04e07.description: After a cult releases an engineered virus, a nurse guarding a limited vaccine supply must decide who among the quarantined survivors receives a chance to live.

s04e08.description: A man cured of crippling fear discovers that the treatment has given him the ability to project terror into other people, making emotion itself a weapon.

s04e09.description: The lone survivor of a Venus disaster begins producing strange duplicate body parts under radiation, suggesting that whatever returned to Earth may no longer be entirely human.

s04e10.description: A scientist warns that the sun of a distant colony will explode, but his earlier failed prediction leaves leaders reluctant to evacuate before the evidence becomes undeniable.

s04e11.description: A family replaces its nanny with a protective android whose rigid programming and growing involvement in the household turn domestic safety into something much more threatening.

s04e12.description: A expelled physics student threatens mass destruction after mastering cold fusion and demands the execution of five people he hates, forcing authorities into an impossible moral bargain.

s04e13.description: A man awakens from cryogenic sleep into a society populated only by women, and his arrival destabilizes relationships in a community built without men.

s04e14.description: A military project gathers gifted psychics in an underground facility, where an unseen attacker begins killing them one by one and suspicion turns inward.

s04e15.description: An ancient cocoon found in a burial chamber imprints an archaeologist with the memories and impulses of a long-dormant alien being.

s04e16.description: A team sent to deploy a doomsday weapon against an alien world is captured and subjected to psychological torture designed to break both loyalty and certainty.

s04e17.description: Alien settlers and escaped human slaves struggle to survive together on a damaged future Earth, where mutual hatred may be more dangerous than the environment around them.

s04e18.description: A scientist continues work on a cellular rejuvenation machine after using it to fight his wife's cancer, and a new relationship tempts him to test the technology again.

s04e19.description: A geneticist alters himself to communicate with beings who seeded Earth with their DNA and is drawn aboard an alien vessel along with his son and several students.

s04e20.description: After catastrophe strikes Earth, rival human bases on Mars accuse one another of causing it, pushing fear and uncertainty toward a war that could finish what the disaster began.

s04e21.description: A veteran returns to civilian life haunted by fragmented memories of a mission and the feeling that someone is following him, forcing him to question what actually happened.

s04e22.description: An emotional android unable to kill humans escapes its laboratory and kidnaps a technician for repairs, developing a bond that complicates the order to bring it back.
